subject: Reverse x-axis in units of time

messages.author: ebb5cae890759eed
messages.subject: Reverse x-axis in units of time
parts:
Hello,

Sorry if this has been asked before, I could not manage to find a solution through the vignettes or searches. Say I have a tree in R,


tree <- rcoal(20)

ggtree(tree) +
  geom_tree() +
  geom_tiplab(size=rel(3)) +
  theme_tree2()

With this plot, the x-axis starts with zero at the root of the tree. I want to reverse the x-axis such that the zero is at the time of the extant species, and positive values of time at the internal branches. I do NOT want to reverse the plot, only the values of the x-axis.

In other words, this
scale_x_reverse()
is not what I want.

Thanks for help,
Bjørn
